classification_rule.REJECT_KEY: key is not a canonical, on-curve, prime-order-subgroup Ed25519 point, or not a canonical Ed25519 SPKI, or a non-canonical base64 spelling — must be refused BEFORE any backend signature check
classification_rule.REJECT_SIG: key domain is fine; the signature must not verify
